choices.text:
The loop at lines 9–12 follows `default_table` pointers through differential states. The bounds check at line 6 only validates the initial state's entry; each subsequent `parent` fetched at line 10 is never rechecked against `state_count` before being used as an index at line 9 and line 14. A differential state can point to an out-of-range parent, causing an out-of-bounds read (and potential infinite loop). The missing recheck is at line 11, where the unchecked parent is assigned to `j`.

Answer: 11
